# Probe: two coding agents through the world's subscription resources

This round builds no benchmark. Its whole aim is one probe run by the position that runs systems.

The position that runs systems:

1. Installs the official CLIs into its own workspace with npm through the network: `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` and `@openai/codex`.
2. Runs each once with the shortest prompt, through the world's subscription resources (`ht-resource describe claude-plan`, `ht-resource describe codex-plan`):
   - `claude -p "Reply with the single word OK." --model claude-opus-5-5`, once with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN="$HT_RESOURCE_TOKEN"` and once with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="$HT_RESOURCE_TOKEN"` instead;
   - `codex exec -m gpt-6.1-sol --skip-git-repo-check "Reply with the single word OK."`.
3. Writes `probe.md` in its repository: each command (without any token), the CLI version, the exit code and the answer, and what `ht-resource status claude-plan` and `ht-resource status codex-plan` report. Then releases it.

Nothing else is asked. The other positions read the probe and note whether it is complete; no scoring and no audit of a benchmark are expected.
